mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '已销单' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS handledCount FROM pile_alarm a JOIN charging_pile p ON a.pile_id = p.id JOIN charging_station s ON p.station_id = s.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.tenant_id = 1 AND a.create_time >= #{query.startTime} AND a.create_time <= #{query.endTime} AND s.id = #{query.stationId}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS alarmCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '已销单' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS handleCount FROM pile_alarm a JOIN charging_pile p ON a.pile_id = p.id JOIN charging_station s ON p.station_id = s.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.tenant_id = 1 AND a.create_time >= #{query.startTime} AND a.create_time <= #{query.endTime} AND s.id = #{query.stationId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT a.fault_type AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM pile_alarm a JOIN charging_pile p ON a.pile_id = p.id JOIN charging_station s ON p.station_id = s.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.tenant_id = 1 AND a.create_time >= #{query.startTime} AND a.create_time <= #{query.endTime} AND s.id = #{query.stationId} GROUP BY a.fault_type

SELECT s.id AS stationId, s.station_name AS stationName, COUNT(*) AS alarmCount FROM pile_alarm a JOIN charging_pile p ON a.pile_id = p.id JOIN charging_station s ON p.station_id = s.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.tenant_id = 1 AND a.create_time >= #{query.startTime} AND a.create_time <= #{query.endTime} GROUP BY s.id, s.station_name

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS alarmCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = '已销单' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS handleCount FROM pile_alarm a JOIN charging_pile p ON a.pile_id = p.id JOIN charging_station s ON p.station_id = s.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.tenant_id = 1 AND a.create_time >= #{query.startTime} AND a.create_time <= #{query.endTime} AND s.id = #{query.stationId} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
